shots.name: brightness-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Brightness card: the Preset menu showing Full Light and the Amount row at 0.70, beside a strip of the preview with the lifted stage
shots.caption: Brightness with the Full Light preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Amount: lighter or darker.

shots.name: contrast-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Contrast card: the Preset menu showing Bold and the Amount row at 1.50, beside a strip of the preview with the deep black stage
shots.caption: Contrast with the Bold preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Amount: flatter or punchier.

shots.name: exposure-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with an Exposure card: the Preset menu showing Milky Haze, Exposure at 0.0 EV, Offset at 0.06 and Gamma at 1.25, beside a strip of the preview with the hazy, lifted stage
shots.caption: Exposure with the Milky Haze preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Exposure: the light, in camera stops. 3 — Offset: lifts or lowers everything. 4 — Gamma: the mid-tones.

shots.name: levels-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Levels card: the Preset menu showing Matte Film, Input Black at 0, Input White at 1, Gamma at 1, Output Black at 0.12 and Output White at 0.90, beside a strip of the preview with the grey, matte stage
shots.caption: Levels with the Matte Film preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Input Black: what becomes black. 3 — Input White: what becomes white. 4 — Gamma: the mid-tones. 5 — Output Black: how dark black is. 6 — Output White: how bright white is.

shots.name: saturation-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Saturation card: the Preset menu showing Rich and the Amount row at 1.35, beside a strip of the preview with the richer harbour
shots.caption: Saturation with the Rich preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Amount: weaker or stronger colour.

shots.name: vibrance-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Vibrance card: the Preset menu showing Strong and the Amount row at 2.00, beside a strip of the preview with the dancer's arm and dress against a deep blue side light, her skin natural
shots.caption: Vibrance with the Strong preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Amount: muted or livelier colour.
